long_biography.plain_text:
Perego entered entertainment as a model at sixteen and reached local television a year later, working beside established comedians on Antenna 3 Lombardia. Fininvest recruited her in 1984, and she developed beyond supporting roles through sports and entertainment formats. Her work on Calciomania brought a Telegatto and established her as a presenter able to move between live conversation and structured studio shows.

Across Italy's major commercial and public broadcasters, she led Forum for five editions, fronted La Talpa and La Fattoria, and handled Sunday, daytime and interview formats. Moving between Mediaset and Rai gave her a career built less around one franchise than around changes of genre and audience. In 2020 she published an autobiographical account of living with panic attacks.
